name: Fritz Wittgenstein
original_name: フリッツ・ヴィトゲンシュタイン
source:
A professional violinist.
Half-Japanese with an Austrian father.
In his home country he lives a life surrounded by maids and butlers, so he's always wanted to try and live like the "common people".
He likes "doing things for other people" so he is perfect with chores and cleaning.
